name: @hi3d/hi3d-cli
description: Hi3D image-to-3D from the terminal and for AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor): login with Open Platform AK/SK or a hi3d.ai account, generate, poll, download, split, relief, multicolor; MCP server included; 2.0 edits models with headless Blender (inspect, repair, decimate, scale, render previews, export, re-texture).
